_note: Formatting fixes to Capcom's close-up rows, reviewed 2026-09-04 (Gemini passes), converted to hash-guarded word-index ops 2026-09-23 (repo-text audit). Applied by default; --verbatim renders the rows untouched. All six rows are hash-guarded edits over the OFFICIAL row the user extracts from their own Collection at build time (condense_generated.py's pattern, reused via tools/txtcut_trim.py): a source hash guards against a Collection whose wording differs, ops are line-break/indent moves ('sep') plus a few word deletions and substitutions, and a result hash confirms the reviewed wording was reproduced; a hash mismatch falls back to rendering that row verbatim and is counted in the build log. A 'sub' op's replacement word is either a plain generic word or, where the row needed to keep Capcom's own word, the row's OWN word with its punctuation moved or its capitalisation changed (never a new word) - the generator checks this mechanically before accepting a row.
